we proposed an efficient architecture for the SLAM problem based on the cloud computing paradigm.

the implementation of a cloud-based FastSLAM2 algorithm that can be executed in real-time and is suitable for a large number of robots in a distributed system.
the design of a cloud robotics architecture for SLAM problem and the implementation of a novel parallel algorithm for the FastSLAM algorithm.
the design of a cloud-based system for SLAM problem.
